script_text: This Aries, the cosmos is about to flip the script on your peace of mind. Early week, Mercury in your 3rd House sextiles Mars in your 5th, making Monday and Tuesday ideal for bold romance and creative pitches. Your ruling planet Mars fires up your love sector, so don't be shy about confessing feelings. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 4th House, stabilizing your home base. Mid-week, however, Venus squares Jupiter in your 7th House, creating tension between partners and domestic demands. Late week brings clarity as the Sun moves into your 2nd House, urging you to lock in finances. Thursday is rough due to the Venus-Jupiter clash. Your career sector in the 10th House gets a boost from Mars trine Saturn, so leverage that Monday drive. Remember your fire element keeps you burning bright, so stay focused. Follow for daily updates.
